results.title: Klandestin WT
results.overview: Richard, an artist, now lives in Tangier. With his help, the young Moroccan Malik manages to reach Europe, the destination of his dreams. That's where Mathilda, a conservative politician, hides him. Amina, Mathilda's assistant, who finally wants to leave her Moroccan roots behind, is called in as a "mediator" to resolve the problem.

results.title: Wavering Soul
results.overview: A young man struggling at college is encountered by a beautiful woman shrouded in blue light. Will he go with her or finish the schooling his late mother paid for?

results.title: Why We Dream
results.overview: When a group of centenarian WWII veterans pilgrimage to Normandy, France to commemorate the anniversary of D-Day, we witness how these landscapes, scarred by war and frozen in time, unlock memories of the lives lost and lived thereafter.

results.title: Mrs. Fleischer Wants to Die!
results.overview: Confronted with her dementia, old, stubborn Mrs. Fleischer stops eating - she wants to die on her own terms. Caregiver Alexandra is tasked and determined to make her eat. With creativity and great bellicosity, these not so dissimilar women challenge each other. Deliberately provocative, mischievously amused, but also with an increasing sense of understanding for each other's struggles, they grow closer...

results.title: Jamie's Wager
results.overview: With the unexpected death of his father, Jamie finds himself in  the middle of his Muslim uncle, Hafiz, and his father’s New-Age  girlfriend, Alicia, at the office of William's Funeral Directors.

results.title: Our Money
results.overview: Cash, securities and debt are based on the fact that everyone honors their obligations and gets into debt. Can we free ourselves when money becomes a shackle? Do we serve money or does it serve us?

results.title: Woof
results.overview: Kevin, a recluse with a peculiar hobby, gets in a heated confrontation with his neighbor.

results.title: MERCKX
results.original_title: Eddy Merckx, dans la roue d'un champion
results.overview: In 1969, the grocery store's son and promising cyclist Eddy Merckx took part in the Tour de France for the first time. He devours the competition and is the first to cross the finish line with a lead of more than seventeen minutes. 'The Cannibal' is born.

results.title: Scott
results.overview: An experimental short film set in London, 1967. Scott Walker leaves pop-sensation The Walker Brother's and stumbles on the inspiration for his solo career.

results.title: Musical Touken Ranbu: Banryouhitou
results.original_title: ミュージカル『刀剣乱舞』 ～花影ゆれる砥水～
results.overview: Musical Touken Ranbu installation following a team led by Mutsunokami during the times of Sakamoto Ryouma.

results.title: The Arborist
results.overview: A grief-stricken arborist and her son awaken a haunting when they begin felling trees at the estate of a mysterious recluse.

results.title: The Other Woman
results.overview: A Woman anxiously awaits a man’s call to feel desired. A Woman and Another Woman- who could be many others, or even the same one—cross paths in the bathroom of a bar that could be like so many others.

results.title: Mascarade
results.overview: A young woman visits her parents' apartment for their 10-year anniversary and tensions arise when none of the guests show up.

results.title: The Wildman of Shaggy Creek
results.overview: When a young boy discovers a Bigfoot monster may be lurking in the woods behind his house, he must face his fear to uncover the truth.

results.title: After This Death
results.overview: A woman's affair with an enigmatic underground musician throws her life into chaos when he disappears. Forced to fend off his obsessive fans, she also has to confront her fractured marriage, and reclaim her identity and her future.

results.title: The War Between
results.overview: Two soldiers from opposing sides of the American Civil War must cooperate in order to survive being stranded in the Arizona Desert.

results.title: Gypsy en el Soho. El sueño de Antonio Banderas
results.original_title: Gypsy en el Soho. El sueño de Antonio Banderas
results.overview: To mark the premiere of his theatrical version of the musical GYPSY at the Teatro del Soho Caixbank, Antonio Banderas reviews his life, his motivations, and his dream of returning to Malaga to direct a theater in an extensive interview.

results.title: Tears at the Edge of a Prayer Rug 2
results.overview: Baskara celebrated his ninth birthday with Aqilla, but on the other hand, he was also celebrating it with Yumna and his adoptive family in Solo. So, in the next story, will Baskara return to his biological mother, Aqilla? Or will he continue to grow up with his adoptive family in Solo?
